unit_of_independence.proposed: Verified biological experimental unit (possibly a fly pool or vial),grouped with shared mission/hardware/run and technical derivatives.

proposed_policy.train: Fit models and all normalization/feature selection on training groups only,after independence and target review.
proposed_policy.validation: Tune using disjoint verified biological groups;keep all pooled,technical,assay and repeated measurements together.
proposed_policy.test: For mission generalization,hold out an independent mission/study/cohort,with overlapping source experiments and duplicates excluded. This one-study snapshot cannot establish such a test.
